name: get_case
description: Fetch a case's current state: metadata (patient, hospital, reply-to address), the summary of documents on file, every signed audit finding, and every drafted/sent action. Use this to check what's already known about a case before asking the patient to repeat themselves.

name: save_extraction
description: Save one piece of structured, extracted data onto a case -- an itemized bill, an insurance EOB, household/income info, or a good-faith estimate. The payload is validated against the matching engine schema for that kind; an invalid payload is rejected with an error rather than silently stored. Call this once per extracted document before running audit_case.

kind.description: Kind of document being saved: bill, eob, household, or gfe

payload.description: Extracted data matching the engine's Bill/EOB/Household/GFE schema for this kind

name: draft_action
description: Draft a dispute letter, financial-assistance application, itemized-bill request, or escalation letter for human approval. Every dollar amount and procedure code the letter cites is checked against the case's signed findings and bill (grounding); a letter that invents a figure is rejected (status rejected_grounding, not sendable) instead of silently drafted. On success, follow up by calling the matching actions___* tool with the returned action_id once an approval_token has been supplied -- never invent or reuse a token from another action.

type.description: Action type: dispute_letter, fap_application, itemized_request, or escalation

finding_ids.description: Ids of the signed findings this action cites (empty array if none apply)

letter_markdown.description: Full markdown text of the letter; every $amount and procedure code in it must be traceable to a cited finding or the bill

disputed_amount_cents.description: Total amount being disputed or requested, in cents (0 if not applicable to this action type)

channel.description: Required only when type is escalation: NSA_HELPDESK, STATE_AG, CFPB, or STATE_INSURANCE
